meta.note: Frozen snapshot of the complete 8x8 export covering 2026-01-01 through 2026-09-14, taken before switching to monthly exports. The 8x8 Search Evaluations export caps at 10,000 rows and this period reached 9,977. Later periods are exported one month at a time into the data/ folder and merged on top of this base by index.html. Columns are the untouched export columns. Columns listed in dictCols hold integer indexes into dicts to keep the file small.
